newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Int'l Comm'l Bank cuts prime rate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Int'l Comm'l Bank cuts prime rate.

text.p: International Commercial Bank of China, one of Taiwan's leading banks, said it was trimming its prime lending rate to 7.430 percent from 7.445 percent, effective Wednesday.
It was also cutting its one-month to three-year time deposits rates by between 0.05 and 0.15 percentage points, effective from Wednesday, the bank said in a statement.
The bank is the latest to cut interest rates in the past week, a trend triggered by Bank of Taiwan, the island's leading commercial bank.
Taiwan Cooperative Bank, Farmers Bank of China, First Commerical Bank and Chang Hwa Bank all followed suit late last week.
The banks said the rate cuts reflected the current loose liquidity in the banking system.
